# couchbase-capella_data_api (Resource)

This resource allows you to enable or disable the Data API and network peering for an operational cluster.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "couchbase-capella_data_api" "new_data_api" {
  organization_id        = "<organization_id>"
  project_id             = "<project_id>"
  cluster_id             = "<cluster_id>"
  enable_data_api        = true
  enable_network_peering = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `cluster_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the cluster.
- `enable_data_api` (Boolean)
- `organization_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the organization.
- `project_id` (String) The GUID4 ID of the project.

### Optional

- `enable_network_peering` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `connection_string` (String)
- `state_for_data_api` (String)
- `state_for_network_peering` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import couchbase-capella_data_api.new_data_api cluster_id=<cluster_id>,project_id=<project_id>,organization_id=<organization_id>
```
